description: Container image registry and repository allow/reject policy.
doc: Configures a whitelist or blacklist of container registries and repositories on the device.

mappings.doc: Specifies whether the entries in `/repositories` are allowed or rejected. Allowed values: [Whitelist, Blacklist]. Unset returns to the default state configured on the device.

mappings.description: List of registry and repository prefixes to allow or reject.
mappings.doc: List of registry names and optional repository paths in the form `registry-host[:port][/repository-path]` to allow (when `/mode` is `Whitelist`) or reject (when `/mode` is `Blacklist`).
